    Band modules of every rank #

    For a band b (alternating, killing zero paths, primitive), a multiplicity space V and a twist φ ∈ GL(V), b.BMV S hA hK φ is the band block module. The band module M(ω, μ, n) of the paper is b.bandModule S hA hK n μ, the block module with twist the Jordan block J_n(μ) (jordanEquiv).

    At the first position, the numerator of the pair functor splits as ι(V) ⊕ denB (exists_unique_split), where ι places a vector in the first block. A module map g between band block modules therefore induces hat g : V → V', which intertwines the twists (hat_comm, by following the chain around the band) and is functorial (hat_comp). This gives:

    • isIndecomposable_BMV: M(V, φ) is indecomposable if φ has no nontrivial commuting idempotent; in particular every M(ω, μ, n) is indecomposable (isIndecomposable_bandModule);
    • conj_of_equiv: isomorphic band block modules have similar twists; in particular M(ω, μ, n) ≅ M(ω, μ', n) forces μ = μ' (eq_of_bandModule_equiv);
    • exists_equiv_bandModule: over an algebraically closed field every indecomposable band block module is some M(ω, μ, n).
